nodes.author: dobahi
nodes.text: 2️⃣The Bali Health Office has started requiring passengers from China and Malaysia to fill out a (Satu Sehat) Health Pass (SSHP) three days before their arrival to the island to record passengers’ health issues such as high body temperature or cold or flu symptoms.
